explication: Claude Code Neovim Plugin embeds the Claude Code CLI in Neovim. Users invoke a command or keymap to toggle the terminal; configuration shapes its window and launch options, and the plugin can choose a Git-root working directory. A separate file-refresh capability updates buffers after external changes. The README documents these capabilities, but no source excerpts were provided, so internal call ownership and finer control flow cannot be verified.
